action.option: Escalate 2018 for annual mortality peak follow-up

brief_basis: The chart 'Year vs. Mortality rate' shows the mortality rate rising over time, with the highest point at the final year, 2018 (approximately 9.1-9.2), which is visibly higher than 2010 (approximately 8.1) and all other years. The task asks to route the year that should receive peak-burden follow-up, which corresponds to the peak year 2018. The option 'Escalate 2018 for annual mortality peak follow-up' matches this.
